text:
deploy-bot: [DEPLOY] Rolling deployment started for service 'inference-api' -> tag v1.43.0. Canary=10% :rocket: Runbook: https://redwood.internal/runbooks/escape-hatch-inference (see 'pin-and-scale' section)

sam: on it, pulling up canary graphs

mia: note: migration flag OFF by default, we enabled partial feature-flip

ops-lead: if 5xx spike >1.5% for 2min -> abort, pin previous tag v1.42.3, and scale replicas to 6. Follow runbook steps 2-5

luis: prepping the pin + image revert commands

deploy-bot: Canary metrics: error_rate=0.4% latency_p95 +0.8% cpu_node=72% :white_check_mark:

sam: seeing increase on model-worker-2: 5xx 2.8% last 60s :rotating_light:

ops-lead: start escape hatch now. Mia/Luis execute these commands and confirm.

luis: running:
```bash
kubectl -n inference set image deploy/inference-api inference-api=redwood/inference-api:v1.42.3
kubectl -n inference rollout status deploy/inference-api --timeout=5m
```

mia: running step 1, re-routing traffic to fallback pool

devops-bot: Auto-snapshot created: s3://backups/inference/2026-03-20-1855554321.tar.gz

luis: rollback command applied, rollout in progress

deploy-bot: Canary aborted. Rollback to v1.42.3 triggered by ops-lead. Notifying owners.

sam: 5xx dropped back to 0.3%, latency normalized :thumbsup:

ops-lead: pinned to v1.42.3 in deployment config and created issue INF-987: 'Investigate model-worker OOMs during v1.43.0 canary'

mia: added post-mortem draft to INF-987, included runbook steps and timeline

ops-lead: good job. We'll re-run a controlled canary after regression fixes. Closing thread.
